item.title: October 2026 Humble Choice
item.description:
Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii


Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 59.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 89% positive, 3886 reviews

Search on Steam

Japanese mobsters and—pirates? That’s right! The Like a Dragon series makes a splash into open water in search of a new kind of glory with an exhilarating mix of land and sea combat in Like a Dragon: Pirate in Hawaii. Embark on an over‑the‑top modern‑day pirate adventure as the protagonist, Goro Majima, an ex‑yakuza who lost his memories and ended up on a remote island in the Pacific. In true Yakuza fashion, combat is as dynamic as ever with new “Mad Dog” and “Sea Dog” fighting styles to enjoy. Recruit a rag‑tag crew of booty‑hungry pirates while upgrading your vessel as you navigate island‑to‑island, defending your turf from cannon fire, cunning swashbucklers, and threats unknown. Recover your memories and kick ass in the process from sunny Hawaii today! Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown


Genres: Action, Adventure

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 29.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 85% positive, 3191 reviews

Search on Steam

You command time in Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown. This installment of the iconic Ubisoft franchise redefines the boundaries of space and time with exciting new features and so much more. Dash through Metroidvania‑style levels with your trademark Time Powers, exciting combat, and point‑to‑point platforming skills to defeat corrupted enemies and mythological creatures inspired by Persian mythology. Find treasures as your strength grows, and solve puzzles with your wits to uncover the source of your world’s widespread corruption. The prince is back and better than ever in Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown. Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

Psychonauts 2


Genres: Action, Adventure

Platforms: linux, mac, windows

Retail price: 59.99 USD

Steam: overwhelmingly positive, 97% positive, 5408 reviews

Search on Steam

Get psyched—literally! Psychonauts 2 introduces a realm of madness and mayhem that defies the boundaries of reality. You play as Raz, a young acrobat with dreams of becoming a Psychonaut, a member of a secret psychic peacekeeping and research organization whose agents dive into their targets’ mindscapes to hunt for information and battle hostile personalities. The game’s third-person view lets you collect and combine powers both physical and mental while you traverse arenas of the subconscious populated by symbolic representations of familiar real-life struggles. Like the minds of its characters, Psychonauts 2 is much more than meets the eye. Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor


Genres: Action

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 12.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 84% positive, 9044 reviews

Search on Steam

You’re a Dwarf miner ready to explore a new planet rich in precious ore. Surely there won’t be bajillions of bug-like enemies waiting around every corner to fight you for territory? Of course there are, but that’s what makes shoot-’em-up mining game Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor so much fun! Planet Hoxxes IV’s procedurally generated map offers a top-down POV on the mazes of caves and canyons you must explore to pass through each level, complete with armies of enemy creatures and powerful bosses to defeat to gain experience. Choose your class, gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and take on an entire planet full of foes in Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor! Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

Cataclismo


Genres: Strategy, Simulation

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 29.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 89% positive, 2297 reviews

Search on Steam

The ultimate castle siege experience has arrived! In Cataclismo you play from a defensive perspective, leading your armies and constructing your fortress to hold fast against blood-thirsty creatures of the Mist. Erect your fortress brick-by-brick with intricate designs, towering structures, and heavily armed exteriors to fend off waves of monsters as they attempt to overwhelm the last remaining foothold of humanity—of which you command. The modular building mechanics easily click together with satisfying efficiency, remain adaptable throughout battle, and never feel stale with endless customization options for you to explore, community-shared creations available online. Raise your swords, and your defenses in Cataclismo! Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers


Genres: Indie, RPG, Strategy

Platforms: linux, mac, windows

Retail price: 14.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 83% positive, 2217 reviews

Search on Steam

It’s you versus the house in Dungeons and Degenerate Gamblers, a blackjack roguelike adventure reminiscent of other excellent card‑based roguelikes in recent memory. Set deep in the underbelly of a seedy tavern and filled to the brim with degenerates, you’ll need to form a powerful deck so broken that it overpowers your cheating opponents. Pick a suit: hearts for healing, diamonds for extra cash, clubs for damage boosting, or spades for shield boosting—and complete your deck with tarot cards, business cards, birthday cards, hall passes, and more (yes, you read those right). Hit, stand, or go absolutely wild on your way to the top! Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

Asgard's Fall — Viking Survivors


Genres: Indie, Action, Adventure, RPG, Strategy

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 9.99 USD

Steam: mostly positive, 79% positive, 1316 reviews

Search on Steam

Don’t call these Vikings cute, call them deadly! In Asgard's Fall — Viking Survivors you choose from a variety of heroes to prove your might against the corrupt forces of Asgard, then unleash bullet hell through hordes of ungodly creatures with a beautifully bright pixel‑art style rarely associated with the genre. Roguelite elements help you bend fate with randomized power‑ups that stack each round to make you increasingly unstoppable—discover Warpaints, a meta‑progression system of runes that amplify your hero’s abilities, and the Web of Wyrd, which offers a dynamic enhancement mechanic to strengthen your hero on their quest to conquer Asgard. Bring glory to your tribe and an end to the Gods… or visit Valhalla trying! Keys expire. Please redeem and activate your key on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

Toy Shire


Genres: Action, Strategy

Platforms: mac, windows

Retail price: 9.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 87% positive, 702 reviews

Search on Steam

Toy Shire is a playful spin on real-time strategy and tower defense gameplay for an action-packed game that brings you back to your childhood. Let’s go to your childhood bedroom where imagination was your most powerful weapon and combine that joy with the awesome capabilities of modern gaming. This enchanting Toy Realm maximizes the fun with toy soldiers, dinosaur sets, robots, books, and building blocks for your defenses, then unleash attacks onto your enemies with precision attacks! Engage in toyfare across different maps (rooms of your house) where terrain and a number of circumstances will impact your operations. Relive your childhood with this awesome sandbox-style tower defender today!  Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

Might & Mushroom Playtest


Genres: Indie, Adventure, Strategy

Platforms: windows

Search on Steam

Might & Mushroom is an innovative roguelike auto-battler that puts you in control of the RNG through unique "dynamic shop building," allowing you to actively draft and manage your own shop pool. You'll recruit a hilarious multiverse of "Shroom-roes"—legendary heroes reimagined as shape-shifting mushrooms—and strategically deploy them on the board. Once combat begins, your army auto-casts flashy skills based on the Class and Family synergies you've built, letting your tactical positioning do the heavy lifting without tedious micromanagement. This limited time Playtest is an Extra, and DOES NOT provide the game upon its release Keys are available on a first come, first serve basis. Playtest runs from October 13th to November 3rd.
